visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of young individuals, including a main male character wearing a black mask and holding a camera, walk through an underground parking garage with white cars. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor poolside area where scuba diving gear, including tanks and fins, is organized on the tiled floor; characters are seen standing nearby. (3) Detailed close-ups show the characters assembling diving equipment, checking regulators, and preparing buoyancy control devices (BCDs). (4) The main male character is shown in a locker room area putting on a black Mares brand wetsuit, adjusting his hood and mask while others change in the background. (5) Multiple divers are seen underwater in a blue-tiled pool, practicing mask-clearing skills and breathing through regulators while surrounded by rising bubbles. (6) The divers swim horizontally through the water, showcasing their full gear including tanks and fins in a controlled training environment. (7) The video concludes with the main character back on the pool deck in full gear, looking directly into the camera with a bright indoor stadium-style background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat electronic pop music with a moderate tempo and steady kick drum begins. A slight ambient reverb characteristic of a large empty garage accompanies the start. (2) Soft metallic clinking sounds and the rustling of fabric or plastic are heard as equipment is moved onto a hard floor. (3) Short percussive clicks from gear buckles and the distinct high-frequency sound of a zipper being closed occur over the music. (4) The acoustic atmosphere shifts to a dense underwater texture dominated by heavy, low-frequency bubbling sounds and the rhythmic, hollow rasp of breathing through a scuba regulator. (5) Splashing sounds and pool-deck room tone return as the music continues to play until the track fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as a personal vlog documenting a group scuba diving training session. It captures the chronological progression from arriving at the facility, assembling technical gear, donning wetsuits, and finally performing diving exercises underwater in a pool to share the hobby experience.
